subject.title: feat(nodes): add computer use (computer.act) on macOS nodes via Peekaboo

question: Should OpenClaw accept a built-in `computer` tool plus `computer.act` macOS node command as the core desktop-control boundary, or should this remain in Codex/CUA/plugin-owned paths first?
rationale: The PR adds model-driven desktop screenshots and real mouse/keyboard injection through a new dangerous node command, and automation cannot choose the permanent security and product boundary or substitute the missing signed-app proof.

options.title: Fix and prove before merge
options.body: Require the held-input disarm/expiry fix, redacted signed macOS live proof, and security-owner approval before this path lands.

options.title: Pause for plugin/manifest boundary
options.body: Hold this draft until the related Computer Use manifest and plugin-host contract stack settles the intended ownership model.

options.title: Close in favor of existing paths
options.body: Reject the core/node path for now and direct users to Codex Computer Use or `cua-driver` MCP while keeping #97333 for broader design.

recommendation.title: Fix and prove before merge
recommendation.body: Require the held-input disarm/expiry fix, redacted signed macOS live proof, and security-owner approval before this path lands.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest current history across the macOS node, gateway policy, phone-control, and Codex Computer Use surfaces involved.
